messages:
maria: dropped a quick experiment called 'railpeek' for the Usage page. trying a left-rail 'token ribbon' that stays visible while you scan projects. proto: https://redwood.design/railpeek :eyes:
aj: neat name. quick clarifying Q: does the ribbon persist the time range + token denom when switching scope? that was ambiguous in the mock.
sam: noticed that too. switching org->project right now resets denom to USD which is frustrating for token-first flows. can we persist denom at either account or user level? :thinking_face:
rachel: UX thought: the ribbon is great for comparisons, but on mobile it eats vertical space. propose collapsing to a single-line summary with a chevron to expand. store collapse state per user.
tom: accessibility points: ribbon swatches drop below 4:1 contrast in dark mode. change to token-neutral-300 bg. also add aria-label to the scope switcher (screen readers read just "button" today).
maria: good catches. aria snippet: ```html
<button aria-label=\"Scope toggle: organization, project\" role=\"switch\">Org / Project</button>
```
aj: placement debate: Option L puts token ribbon in left rail (sticky) and chart on right. Option S stacks a compact token card above the chart. L is better for scanning; S is denser on small widths. I'm leaning L for desktop + S for mobile.
sam: agree L desktop, S mobile. also add a small control to toggle chart denom (tokens vs USD) client-side using cached conversion rates per date range so we don't hit the invoices endpoint every toggle.\rt: typo? tom: also ensure keyboard focus flows logically: ribbon items should be tabbable and convey their state to assistive tech.
billing-bot: heads-up: invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for users without billing perms. UI should map those to friendly states like "Invoice not available yet" or "Check billing access" instead of surfacing raw 404s.
rachel: copy tweak: instead of "Token ribbon" use "Usage breakdown" in the header and reserve "token ribbon" as a playful internal name in the figma. also change button text to "Download invoice (project)" / "Download invoice (org)" depending on scope; non-admins get disabled with tooltip "billing access required".
maria: action list: 1) persist denom per-user/session (sam) 2) left-rail ribbon on desktop + collapsed single-line on mobile with persisted state (rachel + aj) 3) client-side denom toggle with cached rates and keyboard focus (sam + aj) 4) a11y contrast + aria label fixes (tom) 5) contextual invoice CTA + friendly error mapping (aj + billing-bot) 6) small explainer link "What is token denom?" next to denom toggle that opens compact tooltip and links to docs (maria). I'll update figma and push a tiny A/B prototype for desktop tomorrow. :thumbsup:
aj: once prototype is live we'll do a quick 3-person hallway test and collect notes.
